evidence.coherence: The three technologies form a logical clinical workflow progression—from imaging infrastructure (T01), to AI-guided surgical application (T02), to diagnostic automation (T03)—reflecting a coherent strategy of building a comprehensive AI-augmented medical imaging and diagnostics platform.
evidence.balance: The portfolio is heavily skewed toward Strategic/High tiers with no Low or Medium tier exploratory investments, and all three technologies are concentrated in the imaging/diagnostics subsegment; this creates risk concentration with no hedge against emerging disruptions or early-stage bets.
